selection.method: Editorial selection across ten everyday-scene groups, not a measured frequency list or JLPT syllabus.

dictionary.project: JMdict, Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group
dictionary.retrieval: Previously cached snapshot reused without a new dictionary download. Its upstream release date is not established.
dictionary.verification: Primary readings and complete sense lists inspected in actual compact records; all 100 primary IDs, exact readings and sense counts also matched against the original XML. Full entry records below retain spelling/reading/sense restrictions, including senses not taught by the card.

additional_sources.supports: Explicit gitaigo classification and cheerful-state usage of ukiuki; not a vocabulary-level or frequency source.

identity_and_scope_notes: One primary entry per selected card; no duplicate primary entry within the second 100 and no overlap with starter word IDs.
The three reused cards retain their stable word, reading, title, type, kanji and N3/N3/N4 declarations; previous quiz exclusions are retained.
No new level is inferred for any of the 97 new cards. Category tags are broad sense-level teaching labels, not etymological proofs or grammatical parts of speech.
Meemee uses the exact dictionary-recorded katakana form. Katakana does not imply gairaigo origin.

The pinned JMdict records mark かちかち (1002840) and ぶうぶう (1011120) with reading inf sk, defined by the original XML DTD as search-only kana form. Their cards now disclose that status. The flags were already retained in the full records; they do not establish incorrectness or relative frequency. Keep these stable spelling identities rather than create duplicate cards; regular alternatives include カチカチ and ブーブー/ぶーぶー respectively.
Piyopiyo, potapota and bashabasha do not inherit the senses restricted to hiyohiyo, botabota and pashapasha respectively.
Gokugoku gulping (2178890) is distinguished from the degree adverb (1760690); zokuzoku shivering (1007140) from succession (1596730); mokumoku billowing (2009910) from silence (1605200).
Original examples and contrastive explanations are teaching text, not dictionary/corpus quotations or native-speaker certification.
The text-only batch preserves the existing image pilot, content schema, app behavior and review schedules.
Quiz pairs are direct symmetric safeguards, not transitive cliques or universal substitution claims; broad relation rows are not themselves exclusions.

Review revisions inspect actual primary and secondary senses against both displayed titles, including ordinary vocabulary. Grumbling, pain, vigor, clarity and crowding safeguards are individually curated; no sound-family or grammatical-category clique is generated.
